pathforge_fit_adaptation: The outside demand is saving, remixing, and understanding prompt-gallery material. This PathForge candidate turns that into an offline prompt-remix recipe-card game/editor: users combine audience, task, constraint, and output cards, get deterministic missing-ingredient feedback, and copy or download a clean prompt recipe. It is self-contained and does not depend on external APIs, CDN assets, remote fonts, hosted AI calls, generated media, or third-party prompt text.
